settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.text: Find answers to common questions about DisplaysKart acrylic display stands, shipping, and bulk orders.

settings.question: What is an acrylic display stand?
settings.answer: A clear, lightweight holder made from acrylic (plexiglass) used to display signs, menus, photos, brochures or products.

settings.question: Can I buy acrylic display stands online in India?
settings.answer: Yes. Pan-India delivery on tabletop, riser, wall-mount and floor-standing units.

settings.question: Do you offer sign holders for restaurants and hotels?
settings.answer: Yes — menu holders in A4, A5 and custom sizes.

settings.question: Single-sided vs double-sided sign holder?
settings.answer: Single-sided shows content on one face; double-sided shows it on both, ideal for high-traffic areas.

settings.question: Do you offer a donation box with a lock?
Is free shipping available?
settings.answer: Yes, on all orders above ₹1,000 across India.

settings.question: Can I order wholesale?
settings.answer: Yes. 5% discount on bulk purchases — contact us for a custom quote.
